reason: The intake dependency deliberately freezes only the phrase 'classification of manifolds by bordism'. It does not select the unoriented characteristic-number criterion, the oriented criterion, or a Pontryagin-Thom identification. These are inequivalent propositions with different structures, coefficient conventions, and conclusions. Selecting one would invent missing mathematics. The pinned Mathlib.Geometry.Manifold.Bordism module explicitly implements only the beginnings of unoriented bordism theory and lists bordisms, the bordism relation, bordism groups, and their ring structure as TODOs, so it cannot type an exact Thom classification target.
